        exists = from

        }

    allow = { always = yes }

            from = {

                else = {
                    subtract_variable = { which = bca_reserve_influence_amount value = 100 }

bca_global_settings_expect_output_rare_resource_decrease = {
    potential = { exists = from from = { check_variable = { which = bca_expect_output_rare_crystals value > 0 } } }
    allow = { always = yes }
    effect = {
        custom_tooltip = BCA_GLOBAL_SETTINGS_RARE_RESOURCE_TARGET_SURPLUS_DECREASE_TOOLTIP
        hidden_effect = {
            from = {
                if = {
                    limit = { check_variable = { which = bca_expect_output_rare_crystals value <= 20 } }
                    set_variable = { which = bca_expect_output_rare_crystals value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { which = bca_expect_output_volatile_motes value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { which = bca_expect_output_exotic_gases value = 0 }
                }
                else = {
                    subtract_variable = { which = bca_expect_output_rare_crystals value = 20 }
                    subtract_variable = { which = bca_expect_output_volatile_motes value = 20 }
                    subtract_variable = { which = bca_expect_output_exotic_gases value = 20 }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}


bca_global_settings_expect_output_rare_resource_increase = {
    potential = { exists = from }
    allow = { always = yes }
    effect = {
        custom_tooltip = BCA_GLOBAL_SETTINGS_RARE_RESOURCE_TARGET_SURPLUS_INCREASE_TOOLTIP
        hidden_effect = {
            from = {
                change_variable = { which = bca_expect_output_rare_crystals value = 20 }
                change_variable = { which = bca_expect_output_volatile_motes value = 20 }
                change_variable = { which = bca_expect_output_exotic_gases value = 20 }
            }
        }
    }
}
